cue.heading: 28 U.S.C. § 1257(a) — review of state-court decisions
cue.text: <mark>Final judgments or decrees</mark> rendered by the highest court of a State in which a decision could be had, may be reviewed by the Supreme Court by writ of certiorari where … any title, right, privilege, or immunity is specially set up or claimed under the Constitution or the treaties or statutes of … the United States.
highlight: final determination from the state court
